budget_items.topic: Public Safety Building feasibility study quote
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The quote to prepare a feasibility study on the Public Safety Building oil to gas conversion came in at $2,500.00 and was approved for submission to the DOER.

budget_items.quote: the msba will most likely reduce their contributions by the percentage of what was saved in incentives.
